description: Source file defining a React component 'DoctorListAndBooking' that fetches and displays a list of doctors and their available appointment slots. It allows users to book an appointment slot via interactions that call backend APIs. The file includes utility functions for fetching doctors with slots and booking appointments, and manages UI state including loading, booking status, and the list of doctors.

methods.name: fetchDoctorsWithSlots(token)
methods.description: Fetches all available doctors and their open time slots from the backend API /api/patient/doctors_with_slots, using the provided JWT token for authorization.

methods.name: bookAppointment(slotId, token)
methods.description: Attempts to book an appointment for a specific slot ID using the backend API /api/patient/book_appointment with the provided JWT token.

methods.name: DoctorListAndBooking()
methods.description: React functional component that displays a list of doctors with their available slots. Allows patients to book slots, handles loading states, fetches data from backend, and provides user feedback.
